sentence: Demo steps 1 and 8: a mock TAMM page leads to a claimed invite, and the clinic opens the person's ticket and sees "Not shared by the person" for a free-text note they kept back, with its value in no response body
A ticket from a claimed TAMM invite has source TAMM
A revoked ticket shows "Withdrawn by the person" and no data
After "Unable to see", the person app shows the reroute prompt
The exported Bundle validates against R4 and contains no unconsented element
A bad signature and a replayed request are both rejected with no invite row
A clinician at the other facility gets 404
When the browser will not keep the session the sign-in page says so and does not say the person is signed in
A sign-in link requested on the page, logged by the API, opened in the browser and used signs the person in and keeps the session
The clinician and ops home pages lead to sign-in without a valid session and request no data
The staff pages and the API send their security policy, a page cannot reach any origin but the API, and the pages cannot be framed
A ticket whose share ended is not in the queue or its counts, and the detail answers 410 for it
"Unable to see" needs one reason from a fixed list, sends it as an unable request, and is offered only while the ticket can be rerouted
A seeded withdrawn ticket, which has no consent rows, opens as a ticket with nothing shared, never as "Withdrawn by the person"
When a stop removes the approved summary the live ticket shows no summary, and the export leaves it out
An invite is claimed by the link or by typing the code, only when the person presses the button, and a bad, unknown or taken code is told apart
The mock TAMM page is labelled as a mock and links to the claim screen with the code
The clinician screens hold the plan's type, colours, radii and 44 px tap targets
The clinician queue and ticket detail match the committed snapshots
At 390 wide, in both languages, the clinician sign-in page has the language toggle, naming the other language, as a 44 px target
Choosing a tier in the queue's tier select narrows the list to that tier, and clearing it brings the rest back
With DEMO_MODE unset the demo routes return 404 for everyone, the clock read answers zero, and the admin panel disables its controls and still shows last_verified
A phone whose person the server no longer holds registers again, settles on a screen with no ticket and a way forward instead of an error, and can send a new referral

The crisis_line role signs in through the staff page, reads a hand-off the person consented to (language, totals, "item 9 positive", the callback number if given) in a console labelled as a mock, and marking contact made completes the crisis event as confirmed by the mock line; the raw row is ciphertext, and after the person stops sharing the raw row is gone, the console no longer lists it and a direct read is 404

A crisis_line session opens only the console: the ops pages send it to sign-in, an ops session is sent away from the console, and the API refuses it the dashboard, the queue, a ticket, its bundle and its export

When the hand-off cannot be sent the panel says so, nothing is stored, and the crisis screen still shows every number, the block survives a reload and a direct visit to the options, and "I'm safe right now" still releases it

When the server answers a send as already stopped, the panel says the note was not sent, the form stays open with the agreement cleared and its send button not ready, nothing is stored, and ticking again makes it ready
Pressing "contact made" on a hand-off the person has since stopped sharing is refused with a message, the list is read again without it, and the crisis event is not completed

After a note was sent in one crisis and the crisis screen released, a second crisis on the same phone offers a new note instead of the first one's sent line; sending it leaves the server with two hand-offs; Settings lists two Stop controls, each described by its own note, and stopping one leaves the other

The clinician detail shows the PHQ-9/GAD-7 trajectory beside the self-reported conditions in one panel, with sample labs under the label "Sample — would come from Malaffi" only when conditions are shared; the export holds the conditions and no lab; kept-back conditions show the neutral "Not shared by the person" and no lab; stopping them removes both

A clinic without portal access is given a logged one-time link; opened with no sign-in it shows only the ticket code, tier, state and deadline under a mock-channel label, Acknowledge moves the ticket once as the clinic and logs a fresh link, the used, tampered or wrong-ticket link is refused alike, the fresh link marks seen, and a ticket whose person ended the share answers as withdrawn; the token is only ever in a request body

Once a clinic link has loaded, the address bar and the tab's history hold the page's path and no ticket id or token, and a second link pasted into the same tab leaves no trace of its own either and shows the second ticket; the page still makes its move from the credential it kept in memory; and a reload, which has no credential, shows the missing-link answer and nothing about the ticket

When the answer to a clinic link's move never arrives the page says it could not confirm it and to open the link again (never that the link was not used); when the move was recorded but the next link could not be made it says so and to contact the service, never that nothing more is asked of the clinic
